messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline. Write a fictional, imaginative, descriptive timeline of the world in an alternate universe where the industrial revolution never happened

message.content:
1300 The wind-woven mills of the river kingdoms turn slowly, and scholars chart the stars by candlelight, while the sea-trade caravans carry silk, spices, and stories across a world that has never known the roar of coal, all in the year 1300
1500 The printing guilds of the alpine valleys multiply hand-cranked presses, spreading myths and maps to a world where steam remains a whisper in hot springs, and the great cities glow with oil lamps rather than electric light, all by the year 1500
1700 The clockwork gardens of the eastern archipelago grow in spirals of brass and living vines, tended by engineers who still measure power by the breath of animals and the pull of tides, and the northern empires trade furs, glass, and dreams along roads that never smell of smoke, all during the year 1700
1900 The last great steamship of the old myth sails under sails alone, and the cities hum with the chatter of birds and the clatter of horses, their bridges grown from stone and coral, their libraries filled with ink and star-charts, all through the year 1900
2100 The floating forests of the inland seas carry gardens across continents, and the sky-whales of the upper winds carry mail between mountain towers, while the deep mines of the earth breathe through tidal lungs and never burn a single ton of coal, all by the year 2100
2500 The children of the highlands ride the song of the wind across glass deserts, remembering the quiet centuries before machines that ate the world, and they whisper the old name of the age that never came, all in the year 2500
